column6: The back-translation maintains the same core message and intent as the original, with only slight variations in wording that do not alter the overall meaning.
column7: Let us press on together. Stand firm in sound doctrine, walk boldly in faith, and proclaim the Gospel with confidence. The world desperately needs the light of Christ, and you, equipped with the truth, are called to shine.
column8: Let us run our race together. Hold fast to sound doctrine, walk boldly in faith, and proclaim the Gospel with confidence. The world desperately needs the light of Christ, and you, equipped with the truth, are called to shine.
